div.head: II Cn 84.6
div.ab: God ælmihtig us eallum gemiltsige, swa his (milda) willa sig (⁊ gehealde us æfre on ecnesse! Si hit swa!) Amen.
God ælmihtig us eallum gemiltsie, swa his willa sy! Amen.
God ælmihtig us eallum gemiltsyge, swa his wille sy! Amen.
Deus omnipotens omnibus nobis indulgeat, sicut ei velle sit! Amen.
Deus omnipotens omnibus nobis miser[e]at[ur, sicut] libitum sit.
God ælmihtig us eallum gemiltsie swa his willa sy. Amen.
God ælmihtig us eallum gemiltsige, swa his milda willa sig and gehealde us æfre on ecnesse. Si hit swa. Amen.
Gott der Allmächtige sei uns allen gnädig, wie sein (gnädiger G) Wille sei (und bewahre uns immer in Ewigkeit! Also sei es! G) Amen.
May God Almighty be merciful to us all, as his (merciful, G) will may be (and keep us always in eternity! So be it!, G) Amen.
God Almighty have mercy upon us all, as His will may be. Amen.
May God almighty have mercy upon us all, just as his merciful will may be, and preserve us forever in eternity. May it be so. Amen
div.note: The words in brackets (‘milda’ and ‘⁊ gehealde … swa!’) are only in G; Liebermann thinks them not original.; BR: added from Gesetze I p. 371, October 2026 (MS Cons)
